'''Sakinomiya Shrine''' (さきのみやじんじゃ) is a [[Shinto shrine]] located in [[Suwa, Nagano|Suwa City]], Nagano Prefecture, Japan.

== Overview ==
[[File:先宮神社 - Sakinomiya Shrine 03.jpg|thumb|180px|right|The Shrine Building and the Keyaki Tree (designated as a Suwa City [[Natural monument|Natural Monument]]<ref>[https://www.city.suwa.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/2152.html Cultural Property Division - Suwa City] See related file "List of Cultural Properties."</ref>) ]]
The shrine is associated with a legend involving [[Takeminakata]], the deity enshrined at [[Suwa-taisha]]. When Takeminakata arrived in Suwa, a conflict ensued with the local Yamato clan. After their defeat, the Yamato clan promised not to leave the Daimon area and vowed not to build a bridge over the small stream in front of the shrine. Like other shrines in the [[Suwa Region]], the corners of the worship hall (haiden) are adorned with [[Onbashira]] poles.
[[File:先宮神社 - Sakinomiya Shrine 01.jpg|thumb|180px|right|The Chozuya on the right]]

== Deities ==
The main deity enshrined is [[Takateruhime no Mikoto]].<ref>[http://www.8tree.com/sakinomiya/ Sakinomiya Shrine - Homepage]{{Broken link|date=2024th year 10月}}</ref>

== location ==
The shrine is located at:
* Daimon 3-18-1, Suwa City, Nagano Prefecture, Japan.

== Access ==
The shrine is approximately 1 kilometer north of JR [[Kami-Suwa Station|Kamisuwa Station]].
